title: Restore Product Editor styling (blue primary buttons, non-white editor surface) and fix transparent Instructions modal

requirements.text: Reintroduce a blue primary action style across the Product Editor experience so primary buttons (e.g., “Generate”, “Generate All Products”) render with a clearly blue background (not purple) and readable contrast in both light and dark themes by updating the global theme tokens in frontend/src/index.css.

quotes: I preferred when there were blue buttons in the original design

acceptanceCriteria: In light theme, primary buttons render with a clearly blue fill (not purple) and meet readable contrast against button text.
In dark theme, primary buttons still render blue and remain readable (no low-contrast text).
Buttons that use the default variant (e.g., ProductsWorkspace “Generate All Products”, ProductEditor “Generate”) visually match the updated blue primary color without additional per-button overrides.

requirements.text: Fix the Product Editor page background/surface styling so it does not appear “completely white”; restore an accented/surfaced look (subtle tint/gradient or muted panel treatment) consistent with the app theme when viewing the product editor workspace and editor card(s) (frontend/src/components/products/ProductsWorkspace.tsx and frontend/src/components/products/ProductEditor.tsx).
acceptanceCriteria: The Product Editor workspace area has a visible surface treatment (e.g., muted/tinted container or subtle gradient) so the page does not look like flat white-on-white in light theme.
The ProductEditor card remains visually distinct from the surrounding page (clear border/shadow/surface separation).
No changes to product editing functionality, autosave behavior, or generation logic.

requirements.text: Make the onboarding/popup Instructions window fully opaque and easy to read by updating frontend/src/components/onboarding/OnboardingInstructionsModal.tsx to apply a solid background and appropriate border/shadow styling to the DialogContent (avoid transparent/translucent content that reduces legibility).

quotes: The popup instruction window is transparent now and hard to read

acceptanceCriteria: When the Instructions modal is open, the modal panel (DialogContent) has an opaque background and text is clearly readable over the page behind it.
The Instructions modal retains its existing responsive sizing and scrolling behavior (no regression to scrollability on tablet/touch).
No change to the Instructions content structure or navigation behavior; only visual/legibility fixes.

constraints: Keep all user-facing text in English.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components are read-only); fix styling via composition/classes in feature components and via theme tokens in frontend/src/index.css.
Do not change backend logic or schema (single-actor backend remains unchanged).
nonGoals: Rebuilding or redesigning the Export, Storefront, or Unified Preview screens beyond any incidental theme-token impact.
Introducing new navigation, new features, or new generation/export behaviors.
